subject: Poolshot: multi-variant GPU pool sizing & reserve timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Michael Rao <michael@heliosanalytics.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Poolshot: multi-variant GPU pool sizing & reserve timeline

Michael / Sonia —

Thanks for the productive call this morning. I've pulled together a concise mutual action plan (MAP) draft focused on capacity reservation needs for your Dedicated and Private deployment options — calling this the "poolshot" plan to keep versions distinct. Key points up front:

- Target final commit date (customer side): 2027-06-30 (we can adjust if procurement needs shift).
- Pilot tranche (low-risk): 8x H100 or equivalent, ~2-week performance baseline.
- Production tranche (scale): 32–48 GPUs depending on throughput targets; we suggest a 2-tranche ramp (pilot -> +20 -> full).
- Lead times (typical): Dedicated ~8–12 weeks, Private (VPC/on-prem with KMS) ~12–16 weeks — Private can add 2–4 weeks for network/config validation and HSM/KMS onboarding.

Attached: a one-page MAP draft and a sizing workbook with three scenarios (conservative, target, aggressive). Please review the acceptance criteria sections — those will be the gating items for final commit.

Action items I propose from our side:
1) We (Redwood) will run a short-run perf baseline on your sample model once you confirm the pilot config (owner: Ben Carter; ETA: 06/07).
2) Security & compliance checklist for Private: internal checklist + KMS integration notes (owner: Priyom Das; ETA: 06/10).
3) Plan signature + commercial terms: we can route a DocuSign for the first tranche to accelerate provisioning (owner: Stephanie; ETA: 06/03).

Could you confirm: 1) whether Helios can commit to the pilot tranche by 06/15 for us to meet the 06/30 commit target, and 2) any internal procurement blackout weeks in June?

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: poolshot_map_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 780 KB)]
[Attachment: gpu-sizing-scenarios.xlsx (XLSX, 320 KB)]

From: Michael Rao <michael@heliosanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Poolshot: multi-variant GPU pool sizing & reserve timeline

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clean MAP. Two quick notes from procurement/ops at Helios:

- Our preferred final commit window is tighter than 06/30 if we want the tranche to align with an upcoming project milestone. Can we accelerate the pilot sign-off to 06/10? That would force our procurement to expedite internal approvals.
- We have a vendor evaluation blackout the week of 06/21 due to fiscal year-end audits. If the final commit slips into late June it could be risky.

I'll attach our internal procurement timeline so you can see the gating approvals.

If Redwood can guarantee the pilot spin-up within 2 weeks of receiving the signed tranche order (and confirm a hard cutoff for Private onboarding work), I'll push to get legal to clear the initial PO.

Thanks —
Michael
Director of ML Ops | Helios Analytics
[michael@heliosanalytics.com]
[Attachment: helios_procurement_timeline.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Poolshot: multi-variant GPU pool sizing & reserve timeline

Steph / team —

Quick internal note after reading Helios' timeline: we can compress the pilot schedule if we ship a pre-provisioned pilot image and limit the early acceptance criteria to throughput and correctness (postpone long-tail integration checks until tranche 2). Suggested modification to MAP:

- Pilot: 8 GPUs (H100), provisioning window target: 10 business days from signed order if we do prebuilt image + onboarding checklist.
- Tranche 2: +20 GPUs; run full integration tests (KV cache warmup, latency SLOs) — target 6 weeks after pilot sign-off.
- Private deployment adds ~2 weeks to each milestone for network HLD review and KMS proof-of-concept; call out HSM certs as a separate deliverable.

I think offering a "fast-pilot" option gets Helios what they need for the 06/10 internal deadline while pushing the heavy lift to tranche 2.

Ben
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com

Thanks for the transparency, Michael — and great input Ben.

We can support the accelerated route with a fast-pilot option:

Proposed updated commitments (fast-pilot path):
- Pilot (fast): 8x H100 provisioned from prebuilt image; Redwood ETA = 10 business days from signed order. Target pilot sign-off: 2027-06-10.
- Tranche 2 (scale): +20 GPUs, full integration + performance acceptance; target complete: 6 weeks after pilot sign-off (approx 2027-07-22).
- Private deployment: add 2 weeks per milestone for KMS/HSM onboarding and network validation.

Immediate actions:
- Michael to confirm whether Helios can sign the pilot tranche by 2027-06-03 so we can meet the 06/10 sign-off target.
- Priyom to start KMS scoping call (owner: Priyom Das; target: 06/04).
- Ben to prepare prebuilt pilot image + runbook (owner: Ben Carter; target: 06/08).
- I will send a one-click DocuSign for the pilot tranche (link below) so legal/procurement can route quickly.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/EnvelopeID/XYZ123
Drive MAP & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_poolshot_MAP
HubSpot record: HS-43218

If we get your sign-off by EOD 2027-06-03 we'll commit to the 06/10 pilot sign-off target; otherwise we'll agree a new cadence that avoids the 06/21 blackout.

Best regards,
